description:
Is a US street address in a designated Qualified Opportunity Zone? Checks the address's 2010 census tract (the
        boundaries the designated zones keep) against the official list (IRS Notice 2018-48 and Notice 2019-42, 8,764
        tracts; designations end December 31, 2028, Puerto Rico's December 31, 2027), and its 2020 tract against the Rev.
        Proc. 2026-14 list of tracts ELIGIBLE FOR NOMINATION as 2027 zones (eligible is not designated: governors nominate,
        Treasury designates, new zones run January 1, 2027 to December 31, 2036). designated null = the 2010 tract service
        did not answer (not a no). Not tax advice.
name: opportunity_zone_lookup
